description: List every plugin in the public dsh-plugin-certification registry, each with its repository, letter grade and snapshot date, plus the registry spec version, its generation timestamp and the total count. The returned `coverage` object states what that count is and is not: the registry is an opt-in subset of the ecosystem (a plugin appears only after it was evaluated), so a short list — the bundled snapshot holds one entry — is not evidence that the ecosystem is uncertified, and a single-entry list supports no comparison across plugins. Read `coverage` before drawing any conclusion from `count`. Use this to discover what is in the registry, or to compare grades across plugins. Use get_certification instead when you already know the plugin and want its full five-dimension evidence; this tool returns the summary row only. Read-only: it reads the embedded registry snapshot (optionally refreshed from the public registry when reachable), takes no parameters, performs no writes and needs no credentials. Repeated calls are identical until the snapshot is refreshed.
name: list_certified
title: List every certified plugin
